contributions.detail: delta -2880.86 - 44 row(s) sum to 7579.00 against the cover's own total contributions line, CUMULATIVE column, which prints 10459.86. Both figures retained verbatim; no row was adjusted and the stated total was not recomputed. || TRANSCRIBER'S ACCOUNT: CUMULATIVE-REGIME FILING, and the composition closes exactly. Cover: last report 2,997.23 + this report 7,462.63 = cumulative 10,459.86 (the filer's own three cells; verified). The itemized layer covers only THIS period: the p2 Amount column sums to 7,379.00 and the p2 'Fee Paid by Donor' column sums to 83.63; 7,379.00 + 83.63 = 7,462.63 = the cover's THIS REPORT cell EXACTLY — i.e. the filer totalled the GROSS 'Total charged' column. That identity gates every one of the 43 amounts. The 2,997.23 carried in from the June report is NOT itemized in this document. The p3 hand-written IN-KIND row (200.00) is EXCLUDED from the filer's total (adding it breaks the identity) — kept with in_kind=true. Reported itemized figure 7,579.00 = 7,379.00 cash + 200.00 in-kind; stated 10,459.86 retained verbatim, never recomputed.

expenditures.anchor: the cover's own total expenses line, CUMULATIVE column
expenditures.detail: delta -793.58 - 48 row(s) sum to 7835.75 against the cover's own total expenses line, CUMULATIVE column, which prints 8629.33. Both figures retained verbatim; no row was adjusted and the stated total was not recomputed. 1 row(s) carry an ILLEGIBLE amount and are excluded from the sum, so this side is a FLOOR. || TRANSCRIBER'S ACCOUNT: CUMULATIVE-REGIME FILING plus one unprinted amount. Cover: last report 525.58 + this report 8,103.75 = cumulative 8,629.33 (checks exactly). The 48 itemized rows (p4 33 + p5 15) cover THIS period only; 47 of them carry a legible figure and sum to 7,835.75. The 48th (p5 row slot 0, 'The Peak radio Ad', 8/19/2020) has an EMPTY Amount cell, so the itemized side is a FLOOR. 8,103.75 - 7,835.75 = 268.00, the exact residual attributable to that one blank row — stated here, NOT written into the row. Independent cross-check: all 29 p4 'Fundhero credit card fees' rows map date-for-date and cent-for-cent onto the p2 contribution rows' processing fees.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: No page prints its own TOTAL row on this variant. Two filing-level identities were used as gates and BOTH close: (1) contributions p2 Amount 7,379.00 + Fee-Paid-by-Donor 83.63 = 7,462.63 = cover THIS REPORT contributions — GATE PASSES; (2) expenditures p4 181.91 + p5 legible 7,653.84 = 7,835.75, + the single blank-amount row's implied 268.00 = 8,103.75 = cover THIS REPORT expenses — GATE PASSES with one row's figure unprinted. Cover internal arithmetic also closes on both lines (2,997.23+7,462.63=10,459.86; 525.58+8,103.75=8,629.33).
